name: Troll
purpose: Perform a deliberately stupid or absurd premise with a straight face, so an audience with the relevant knowledge recognizes the joke.

structure.instruction: State the absurd premise sincerely, without announcing the joke.
Commit to the misunderstanding with concise, internally coherent but deliberately wrong reasoning.
Land or sustain the bit. If comment bait is selected, add a specific question or sincere-sounding request for help arising from the premise. Do not automatically explain the joke.

review_checks: Is the deliberate misunderstanding legible to the selected in-group?
Is the joke intentional rather than an accidental factual error?
Does any comment request follow naturally from the premise?
note: Troll is the format. Bait is an optional engagement setting; deadpan is the treatment. Joke is a broader conversational description, not a separate registered format.
